changelog.summary: Adds a verified signed-deal to CS acceptance proposal with exact contract, entitlement, owner and duplicate gates.

title: Signed Deal to Onboarding Handoff
description: Verify one signed SaaS deal and have Customer Success accept its exact scope and first-value promise before onboarding starts.
setup_prompt: Use Signed Deal to Onboarding Handoff as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Deal Follow-through Coordinator and Customer Onboarding Coordinator Crews, the exact CRM opportunity, executed agreement and revision, entitlement source, first-value promise, Sales and CS owners, privacy and existing onboarding workflow. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, a validated Sales-to-CS artifact and an explicit receiving-owner acceptance. Run one real manual case, including an unsigned or unresolved control. Only an accepted handoff can feed New Customer to First Value. Selection alone does not create a Crew, provision access, message a customer, change CRM or activate recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Tenant, CRM account, opportunity and customer account IDs
Executed agreement or order form, revision and purchased scope
Contract-backed first-value goal, rule and target date
Sales owner, receiving CS owner and acceptance policy
Current entitlement and provisioning authority source
Manual-only or reviewed event and retry route
